verdict.rationale: Approval workflows are a fair governance axis for a feature-flag platform, so the story applies. The evidence pack never mentions approvals, change requests, or review gates for production flag changes. Environment tiers, SSO/SCIM access management and CLI/CI-CD integration are adjacent features and earn no credit toward a required-approval workflow.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live
